summary: Adds a new Plunge Milling dressup command (CAM_DressupPlungeMilling) that converts horizontal cutting moves of a base operation into a chain of plunges, with StepOver, UseDrillingCycle, PeckDepth, PeckRetract, ChipBreak and DwellTime properties, registered in the Dressup menu; the drill generator gains an internal retract-height validation.
